content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** § 12.1 grants the Base Components licence only to "Customer" (defined as Bluefly, Inc. alone), with no affiliate coverage and no path to add affiliates — a material failure of the LICENSE fallback. § 14.10 already permits assignment of the Agreement to a successor by merger, consolidation or acquisition, so the successor-transfer element is met verbatim and was not re-drafted. The single surgical insertion extends the grant to Customer's Affiliates upon written notice to IBM, leaving all other grant language (including the restriction wording in § 12.1 and the § 14.17/§ 14.11 limitations) untouched. Noted in the rationale, but not redlined, is the "revocable" and non-perpetual character of the licence, which falls short of the preferred position only.
